children: 3M Co reported results for the quarter with revenue of $6.58B and diluted EPS of $2.63, reflecting modest top-line growth and stronger profitability versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income including noncontrolling interests (NCIs)”. ³ Reported as “Earnings per share — diluted”.
Revenue growth was modest (Q3 +1.0%; YTD +1.6%), while adjusted organic growth was stronger (Q3 +3.3% adjusted; YTD +4.5% adjusted).
Strength came from industrial, safety, semiconductor and data center end markets; consumer electronics and automotive were weaker, and lower U.S. retailer inventories weighed on Consumer POS.
Company cited commercial excellence and innovation driving share gains and positive POS trends in select categories.

Operational activity included completion of PFAS manufacturing exit, the July 2026 Madison Fire & Rescue acquisition and formation of a Fire Safety venture to enable strategic focus and asset dispositions.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
